ops.title: Verify and land host-wide warm coalescing (Lane B): build, CI, and live IO gates
ops.description:
Lane B of the 2026-10-12 cache/IO fixes (note d73db18) is implemented as uncommitted edits in the Orca worktree durable-warm-coalesce-20261012 on branch yasyf/durable-warm-coalesce-20261012, base d8108ea (12.93.2). Nothing was compiled or run: the lane never held the host job slot.

What it does: the Go snapshot host owns one resumable warm job per canonical scope (internal/hookd/snapshot_warm.go), workers post a snapshot_warm demand frame instead of running warm loops, and one host-wide allowance paces source + prepared-cache bytes at 4 MiB/s. No cc-transcript change. Native facts behind the design: note 2ce785e.

Artifacts on the host that produced it (may not outlive /tmp): /tmp/ram-pressure-refresh-20261012-1735/warm-scope-design.json (v3), warm-coalesce-result.json, warm-coalesce-progress.json.

Owner decisions taken with a default, each reversible in one constant or one branch:
- `capt-hook transcripts warm` keeps driving its own steps; they are charged to the allowance but never delayed.
- Allowance 4 MiB/s host-wide; demand window 5 minutes; round-robin scheduling.
- A step that read zero bytes is not paced (as before), so a scope answering status=changed with no reads retries back to back until demand lapses.

ops.text: go build and go vet pass for ./internal/hookd and ./internal/wireproto
CI go test passes for ./internal/hookd and ./internal/wireproto, including snapshot_warm_test.go
CI pytest passes for tests/test_worker_graph_warming.py, test_worker_protocol.py, test_protocol_conformance.py, test_transcripts_registration.py and test_snapshot_client.py
Eight workers demanding one scope against a real owner produce one advancing job, measured by owner counters
Aggregate background source + prepared-cache bytes stay at or under the allowance while foreground hook latency does not regress
Owner has confirmed or changed the four defaults listed in the body
